virals_narrative: Google's launch owned the day. Logan Kilpatrick's 'Introducing Gemini 4 Carbon' crossed 1.08M views and 1.6K bookmarks in under 12 hours, while yesterday's Greg Isenberg 'saas is becoming free' kept compounding to 217K. The rest of the watchlist talked about running agents at scale: Aaron Levie predicted 1,000X more token use, Guillermo Rauch framed model aliases as 'DNS for models' and listed three fixes for the AI coding bottleneck (268 bookmarks on 40K, the best save rate of the day), and Andrew Chen confessed he has 10 agents in his email and isn't sure who's running what. For Aubric, the opening is agent sprawl in creative: many AI tools making ads, one place that checks them before they ship.

should I be worried that 4 different AI tools are making ads for our brand and none of them has read our brand guidelines

shipping a lot of variants, though!!!

worth it?
drafts.video_tip: 10s vertical selfie-style. Read the first line straight to camera, deadpan. Cut to a fast scroll of mismatched AI ad variants (wrong logo color, off-tone copy). Snap back to you shrugging on 'worth it?' Let the replies do the work; pin one reply later with how Aubric checks every variant before it ships.

drafts.angle: 'This is like DNS for X' analogy (rides @rauchg)
drafts.draft_en:
Brand rules should work like DNS for creative.

One source of truth that every AI tool resolves against before an ad goes live.

Solves a huge number of problems. From off-brand colors, to claims legal never signed off on, to ads getting rejected after you already bought the media.

That's the layer we're building at Aubric.
drafts.video_tip: 15s screen-capture style. Show three AI tools (image, video, copy) each sending an ad toward a single 'brand rules' box, like DNS lookups resolving to one server. Each ad comes back stamped APPROVE, FIX, or BLOCK. End on the line 'one source of truth' as a text overlay.

drafts.angle: Circled-number fix list for the hot bottleneck, backed by the 1,000X prediction (rides @rauchg and @levie)
drafts.draft_en:
AI will make 1,000X more ads than marketing teams can review today.

Aubric solves the "AI creative review bottleneck" via:
① Brand checks (logo, color, tone, every frame)
② Legal claim checks (only what legal signed off on)
③ Platform policy checks (before you pay for the media)

① is obvious. ③ is where the money leaks.
drafts.video_tip: 20s vertical. Big '1,000X' counter ticks up over a growing wall of ad thumbnails. Then three circled numbers appear one by one with a short clip each (a logo misuse flagged, a claim highlighted red, a platform rejection notice). Hold on '③ is where the money leaks.'
